sentences.text:
Opposite Party  ---------
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN KUMAR RAI ---------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Abdul Allam, Sr.Advocate  : Mr. Mr. Faisal Allam, Advocate For the State : Mr. Shailesh Kr. Sinha ,APP For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. Asif Khan, Advocate  ( through V.C.)
Learned counsel for the O.P. no.2 has appeared through video conferencing and has submitted that the Audio and Video quality are good.

Learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P.
appearing for the State has no objection.

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Bariyatu P.S. Case No. 219 of 2023 for the offences registered under Sections 498A, 323, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 3/4 of dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, pending in the court of learned JMFC-XXI, Ranchi.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner and O.P. No.2/ wife are first cousin and even the family of petitioner and O.P. No.2/ wife is a joint family and marriage took place between them and thereafter she was taken to Bangalore, but as the O.P. No.2/ wife was not interested to remained at Bangalore, therefore, this case has been lodged.
He further pointed out that efforts of mediation has been taken between the parties but it is O.P. No.2/ wife who did not participate in the mediation proceeding.
He also pointed out that petitioner has complied the notice issued under Section 41(A) Cr.P.C.
Upon aforesaid premise, payer for anticipatory bail has been made.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the O.P. No.2 joined virtually and submitted that there is demand of dowry on behalf of petitioner and petitioner was having illicit relation with some other lady and there is specific allegation available on record which could show that petitioner inflicted mental as well as physical cruelty upon O.P. No.2/ wife.
He also pointed out that one prescription of O.P.No.2/ wife is also on record, which corroborates the submission of learned counsel for the O.P. No.2/ wife that she was subjected to physical cruelty.
He also drew attention of this Court towards online transactions from the family of O.P. No.2/ wife by which family/ O.P. No.2 sent money to petitioner's side.
4. Learned APP appearing for the State has opposed the prayer of anticipatory bail.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
6.
From perusal of the record, it transpires that it is a matrimonial discord between the parties.
Without commenting on merit of allegation, this Court, after considering the nature of offence is of the opinion that petitioner is entitle for anticipatory bail.
7. Considering the facts in totality, this Court is inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, petitioner, above named, is directed to surrender before the learned trial Court within four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and the learned trial Court on his surrender, shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees twenty-five thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned JMFC-XXI, Ranchi, in connection with Bariyatu P.S. Case No. 219 of 2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Arun Kumar Rai, J.) Abhishek/
